description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and macros for implementing a simple Most Recently Used (MRU) list cache in the FreeType project. It includes definitions for nodes, lists, comparison, initialization, and management functions, as well as inline macros for list operations.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a node to the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruNode_Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Init
methods.description: Initializes an MRU list with specified class, maximum nodes, data, and memory context.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Reset
methods.description: Resets the MRU list to empty state.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with the MRU list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Find
methods.description: Finds a node in the list matching a key.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_New
methods.description: Creates a new node with a key in the list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a node by key, moving it to the front if found.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific node from the list.

methods.name: FTC_MruList_RemoveSelection
methods.description: Removes nodes matching a selection criteria.
